licenses.text:
an Bibl, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/breBRG/

The edition's own statement of rights (from eBible.org's page for this translation, https://ebible.org/breBRG/copyright.htm):
> The Gospels in the Breton language of France, 1827 edition
> Les Évangiles en breton, édition de 1827
> Public Domain
> Language: Brezhoneg (Breton)
> Translation by: Jean-François le Gonidec
> 2014-08-11

Why this is public domain:
Translator: Jean-François Le Gonidec, 1775-1838, France. Text: "Testamant nevez hon Aotrou Jezuz-Krist", Angoulême, F. Trémeau, 1827. US: published before 1931. France: life plus 70 years ended in 1908.

The verse-per-line archive holds the Bible text in one file, one verse per line, each line starting with its reference (book, chapter:verse); its SQL and XML copies of the same text, eBible.org's description page, style sheet and signature are left out of the source.

Sources of these facts: eBible.org's details page (https://ebible.org/details.php?id=breBRG), the edition's copyright page (https://ebible.org/breBRG/copyright.htm), https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jean-Fran%C3%A7ois_Le_Gonidec; https://archive.org/details/testamantnevezho00lego; https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_countries%27_copyright_lengths; https://copyright.cornell.edu/publicdomain.

note: The verse-numbered twin of ebible-brebrg-f2c7fe3b, for the parallel verses measure only (#35): its tag is verse-numbers alone, which no mixture selects, so it never enters training. eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside.
